title: Every Way the Ocean Kills Doug, Top to Bottom (Marathon)
card: EVERY WAY THE OCEAN KILLS DOUG
intro: Doug has died in every layer of the ocean, and at every link of its food chain. Squid, sharks, whales and things nobody should have photographed. Here they all are, back to back. The water is not on his side.
description: Three full episodes, back to back: the most disturbing deep-sea discoveries at every depth, dying in every layer of the ocean, and how every step of the ocean food chain would kill Doug. Real science, cartoon deaths.
